title: Escalating Houthi Attacks on Saudi Arabia Amid Iran War
description:
Yemen's Houthi rebels have intensified their attacks on Saudi Arabia, claiming responsibility for a drone strike on an Aramco oil refinery in Jazan on August 13, 2026. This attack is part of a broader escalation that includes missile strikes on a cargo ship in the Bab al-Mandab Strait, resulting in six fatalities. The Houthis have also engaged in clashes with Yemeni government forces, raising fears of a renewed civil war. The U.S. military is responding by deploying the USS George Washington to the region. The situation threatens to disrupt key trade routes and escalate regional tensions further. Iran's involvement is evident as it supports the Houthis, complicating diplomatic efforts. The humanitarian crisis in Yemen worsens as fighting escalates, with millions facing food insecurity.

Key Points:
• Houthis launched a drone attack on an Aramco refinery, marking a significant escalation.
• Six crew members died in a missile strike on a cargo ship in the Bab al-Mandab Strait.
• The U.S. is deploying the USS George Washington to the Middle East in response to rising tensions.
